canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "washing-machine"
title "Washing machine"
clock -
initial "idle"
notes 31
  note "Chosen because its natural authoring is a SEQUENCE — fill, then wash, then"
  note "drain, then rinse, then spin — and the format has no word for 'and then'."
  note "Every step of the chain is hand-wired here: each state names its successor"
  note "on `step-done`. Reordering the programme means editing every rule in the"
  note "chain, which is exactly the kind of restructuring the graphical editor is"
  note "supposed to make free."
  note ""
  note "The sharper problem is RINSE COUNT. A machine that rinses three times has"
  note "no more modes than one that rinses twice — rinsing is rinsing — so the"
  note "count cannot be states without duplicating the cycle. And it cannot be"
  note "config either, because config is read, never counted down: this format"
  note "gives a machine no memory beyond the state it is in."
  note ""
  note "The resolution is the same one the elevator forced: the host keeps the"
  note "number and reports a fact. `more-rinses` is the drum controller counting,"
  note "not the machine."
  note ""
  note "Pause makes it three. Resuming must return to whatever step was"
  note "interrupted — a Harel history state — and this format has no history, so"
  note "`paused-in-*` facts carry it and the host remembers. Three instances of one"
  note "rule: COUNTS, INDICES, POSITIONS AND HISTORY LIVE IN THE HOST, because a"
  note "machine here has no memory beyond the state it is in. Nothing in the format"
  note "says so, and a designer who does not know it will build a state per rinse"
  note "and a paused-state per step."
  note ""
  note "Commands make a fourth point, and a happier one. Twelve states share eight"
  note "commands: `fill-drum` serves both Filling and Rinse fill, `tumble` serves"
  note "both Washing and Rinsing. A command is a word in the host's vocabulary,"
  note "not a name for a state, and the reuse is what proves it. There is not one"
  note "exit command in the whole machine — a step ends because the next step"
  note "starts."
states 12
  state "done" "Done" true (entry 1 "chime") (exit 0)
  state "draining" "Draining" false (entry 1 "drain") (exit 0)
  state "filling" "Filling" false (entry 1 "fill-drum") (exit 0)
  state "idle" "Idle" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "locking" "Locking" false (entry 1 "lock-door") (exit 0)
  state "paused" "Paused" false (entry 1 "hold-everything") (exit 0)
  state "prewashing" "Prewash" false (entry 2 "fill-drum" "tumble") (exit 0)
  state "rinse-filling" "Rinse fill" false (entry 1 "fill-drum") (exit 0)
  state "rinsing" "Rinsing" false (entry 1 "tumble") (exit 0)
  state "spinning" "Spinning" false (entry 2 "drain" "spin") (exit 0)
  state "unlocking" "Unlocking" false (entry 1 "unlock-door") (exit 0)
  state "washing" "Washing" false (entry 2 "heat-water" "tumble") (exit 0)
events 6
  event "cancel" "cancel" user
  event "open" "open door" user
  event "pause" "pause" user
  event "resume" "resume" user
  event "start" "start" user
  event "step-done" "step complete" runtime
config 1
  config "has-prewash" "Prewash in this programme" (bool false)
facts 5
  fact "door-shut" "The door is shut"
  fact "drum-wet" "There is water in the drum"
  fact "more-rinses" "The controller wants another rinse"
  fact "paused-in-fill" "Paused while filling"
  fact "paused-in-rinse" "Paused while rinsing"
refusals 4
  refusal "door-ajar" "the door is not shut"
  refusal "door-locked" "the door is locked while the drum is running"
  refusal "not-running" "nothing is running"
  refusal "still-wet" "the drum must drain before the door opens"
commands 9
  command "chime" "Sound the end-of-cycle chime"
  command "drain" "Drain the drum"
  command "fill-drum" "Fill the drum"
  command "heat-water" "Heat the water"
  command "hold-everything" "Hold everything where it is"
  command "lock-door" "Lock the door"
  command "spin" "Spin"
  command "tumble" "Tumble the drum"
  command "unlock-door" "Unlock the door"
rules 72
  rule "done" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "done" "open" (cases 1 (case - (move "idle")))
  rule "done" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-running")))
  rule "done" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-running")))
  rule "done" "start" (cases 1 (case - (move "locking")))
  rule "done" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "draining" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "draining" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "draining" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "draining" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "draining" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "draining" "step-done" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "more-rinses")) (move "rinse-filling")) (case - (move "spinning")))
  rule "filling" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "filling" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "filling" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "filling" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "filling" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "filling" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "washing")))
  rule "idle" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "open" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-running")))
  rule "idle" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-running")))
  rule "idle" "start" (cases 2 (case (not (holds (fact "door-shut"))) (refuse "door-ajar")) (case - (move "locking")))
  rule "idle" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "locking" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "unlocking")))
  rule "locking" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "locking" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "locking" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "locking" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "locking" "step-done" (cases 2 (case (holds (config "has-prewash")) (move "prewashing")) (case - (move "filling")))
  rule "paused" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "paused" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "paused" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "paused" "resume" (cases 3 (case (holds (fact "paused-in-rinse")) (move "rinsing")) (case (holds (fact "paused-in-fill")) (move "filling")) (case - (move "washing")))
  rule "paused" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "paused" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "prewashing" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "prewashing" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "prewashing" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "prewashing" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "prewashing" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "prewashing" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "rinse-filling" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "rinse-filling" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "rinse-filling" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "rinse-filling" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "rinse-filling" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "rinse-filling" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "rinsing")))
  rule "rinsing" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "rinsing" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "rinsing" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "rinsing" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "rinsing" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "rinsing" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "spinning" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "unlocking")))
  rule "spinning" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "spinning" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "spinning" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "spinning" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "spinning" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "unlocking")))
  rule "unlocking" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "unlocking" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "unlocking" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "unlocking" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "unlocking" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "unlocking" "step-done" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "drum-wet")) (refuse "still-wet")) (case - (move "done")))
  rule "washing" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
  rule "washing" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "door-locked")))
  rule "washing" "pause" (cases 1 (case - (move "paused")))
  rule "washing" "resume" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "washing" "start" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "washing" "step-done" (cases 1 (case - (move "draining")))
deadlines 0
